message: The other day, I decided to check the smoke alarms in our house. Honestly, I was dreading it, thinking it would be a boring chore. But then I turned it into a little family event—snacks, a fun timer, and a race to see who could find the alarms the fastest! 🕵️‍♂️ We ended up giggling and sharing stories about the last time we had to use the fire extinguisher (spoiler: it was just a burnt pizza). It reminded me that safety doesn't have to be serious all the time; a little laughter can make even the simplest tasks feel cozy. Have you had any fun moments while getting prepared?
